sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports grid tools
sections.what: Brings in React state, icons, the calendar event type and the store.
sections.why: Likely reason: needed for the form memory, the icons and saving events.

sections.name: TimeBlockGridProps
sections.title: Event inputs
sections.what: Declares that the grid receives a list of calendar events from its parent.
sections.why: Likely reason: the grid only draws what it is given, so the parent controls the content.

sections.name: TimeBlockGrid (part 1)
sections.title: Form memory and add action
sections.what: Holds the new block's title, start time, end time, category and whether the form is open. Sets the hour list from 7 to 21. Saves a new event with a colour picked from its category, ignoring blank titles, then clears the title and closes the form.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the add form simple, with colours tied to category. Reason for the specific colours is not stated.
sections.watch_out: Times are saved without checking that they are in order or that they do not overlap, so bad entries can be stored.

sections.name: TimeBlockGrid (part 2)
sections.title: Add block form and hour matching
sections.what: When adding is turned on, shows a small form for a new time block with a title, start and end time, and category. It also starts the 24-hour list by finding which saved blocks start in each hour.
sections.why: Likely reason: the form only appears on request so the day view stays clean. Likely reason for matching by hour: each block then lands in the correct row of the day.
sections.watch_out: Matching uses the start time text, so a block starting at 09:30 appears in the 09:00 row, and a badly formatted time would silently drop the block from the list.

sections.name: TimeBlockGrid (part 3)
sections.title: Hourly rows and delete buttons
sections.what: Draws each hour as a row with its time label. Blocks starting in that hour appear as coloured chips showing title and time range, with a trash button that shows on hover. Empty hours show a faded Open Time Slot hint on hover.
sections.why: Likely reason: showing controls only on hover keeps the list uncluttered. Reason for the colour tint is not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The trash button deletes the block at once with no confirmation step.

summary: Shows the day's time blocks in a grid with a form to add a new block. Only three of five sections were provided, so the drawing and delete parts are not described here.
purpose: Lets the user plan the day in fixed time slots.
why: Likely reason: planning focus time in fixed slots helps protect it from other work. Reason not stated in the visible code.
how: Holds the form values for title, start time, end time and category. Builds a list of hours from 7 to 21. The Add Timeblock button shows or hides the form. When saved with a title, it sends the new event to the store with a colour picked from its category, then clears the title and closes the form.
inputs: The typed title, start and end times, and the category choice. The events list from the parent. Store functions addCalendarEvent and deleteCalendarEvent.
outputs: A new calendar event saved through the store. How events are drawn is in sections not provided.
risks: Start and end times are not checked, so an end time before the start can be saved. Overlapping blocks are not prevented. Events outside the 7 to 21 range may not display, which cannot be confirmed from the visible code.
debug: If a new block does not appear, check addCalendarEvent in the store and whether the events list passed from CalendarView updates. If times look wrong, check the start and end values. If an event is missing from the grid, check the hour range and the sections not provided.
